nodes.title: DNase-Seq/DNasel-Seq
nodes.scope: Illumina family-level explanatory drawing plus separately qualified, text-supported variants. The visible route is active chromatin → DNase I digestion → isolation of trimmed complexes → DNA extraction → DNA. The leftmost titled chromatin icon is descriptive, with no incoming/outgoing transfer arrow establishing another operation; its yellow DNA highlighting has no legend and is not assigned a chemical modification. The yellow digestion-panel symbols are interpreted in the context of the DNase I label, not as products or defined chemical structures. There are no depicted alternative branches. Catalogue sequencing is a text-only continuation; Pico-Seq, the tagged-AbrB GeF-seq implementation and the cited liDNase-seq variant are independent primary-supported routes, not transfers or chronological steps between methods. The unnamed formaldehyde variation in the card specifies stabilization before digestion and reversal before DNA purification, but does not identify a further protocol; GeF-seq below provides the inspected implementation with a resolved capture interface. Neither bibliography nor CMS date establishes invention or priority.

workflow.scope: Illumina family-level explanatory drawing plus separately qualified, text-supported variants. The visible route is active chromatin → DNase I digestion → isolation of trimmed complexes → DNA extraction → DNA. The leftmost titled chromatin icon is descriptive, with no incoming/outgoing transfer arrow establishing another operation; its yellow DNA highlighting has no legend and is not assigned a chemical modification. The yellow digestion-panel symbols are interpreted in the context of the DNase I label, not as products or defined chemical structures. There are no depicted alternative branches. Catalogue sequencing is a text-only continuation; Pico-Seq, the tagged-AbrB GeF-seq implementation and the cited liDNase-seq variant are independent primary-supported routes, not transfers or chronological steps between methods. The unnamed formaldehyde variation in the card specifies stabilization before digestion and reversal before DNA purification, but does not identify a further protocol; GeF-seq below provides the inspected implementation with a resolved capture interface. Neither bibliography nor CMS date establishes invention or priority.
